domain: exact F2, binary symplectic quotient, no ancillas, primitive alphabet H/S/CNOT/CZ and H/S uncharged
assertions: Two base words, all 4 ambient and 4 restricted targets, 8 local diagonal rank-one blocks, J excluded from all length<=2 CNOT A-block words
proof: Restricted A-block requires at least 3 CNOTs. Every <=1 ambient entangler is local times CNOT/CZ times local, whose two local diagonal blocks have rank2; each target has rank1. Witnesses attain 3 and2. The post-S orbit has exactly4 distinct targets. Exhaustive completeness uses separate finite census, not this local algebra.
